children.text:
मनसैवेदमाप्तव्यं नेह नानास्ति किञ्चन।
मृत्योः स मृत्युं गच्छति य इह नानेव पश्यति॥
children.commentary_text:
### भाष्यम् (२.१.१)

Commentary for the first mantra of the second chapter's first Brahmana. It speaks of realizing the ultimate non-duality through the mind. One who perceives diversity here goes from death to death.

children.text:
यदेवेह तदमुत्र यदमुत्र तदन्विह।
मृत्योः स मृत्युमाप्नोति य इह नानेव पश्यति॥
children.commentary_text:
### भाष्यम् (२.१.२)

Whatever is here is also there; whatever is there is also here. This reinforces the principle of non-duality. Seeing difference leads to the cycle of rebirth.
